note: One entry bears on the study: from 9 to 16 June 2026 INSBU, with the Interior Ministry and UNDP support, ran a national follow-up and training mission of civil-status agents for the 'digitalisation des registres' (births, marriages, deaths) across Burundi, under the title 'Saisie numérique des faits d'état civil 2025'. It is classed archive because the document describes keying, in 2026, the registers of events of 2025; it does not say the event is entered when registered, nor that the keying is routine for each new event. If the parent reads it as routine keying it would be civil, keyed-elsewhere, B;D, offices not-published, as_of 2026-06.
